WITH filtered_sales AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        ss_item_sk,
        ss_quantity,
        ss_list_price,
        ss_coupon_amt,
        ss_sales_price
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE ss_sold_date_sk IN (
        SELECT d_date_sk
        FROM date_dim
        WHERE d_year = 2001
    )
    AND ss_cdemo_sk IN (
        SELECT cd_demo_sk
        FROM customer_demographics
        WHERE cd_gender = 'F'
          AND cd_marital_status = 'W'
          AND cd_education_status = 'College'
    )
    AND ss_promo_sk IN (
        SELECT p_promo_sk
        FROM promotion
        WHERE p_channel_email = 'N'
        UNION ALL
        SELECT p_promo_sk
        FROM promotion
        WHERE p_channel_event = 'N'
    )
)
SELECT
    i.i_item_id,
    avg(fs.ss_quantity) AS agg1,
    avg(fs.ss_list_price) AS agg2,
    avg(fs.ss_coupon_amt) AS agg3,
    avg(fs.ss_sales_price) AS agg4
FROM filtered_sales fs
JOIN item i ON fs.ss_item_sk = i.i_item_sk
GROUP BY i.i_item_id
ORDER BY i.i_item_id
LIMIT 100
